name: Honda Hornet 250 (CB250F)
engine: 249 cc liquid-cooled DOHC inline four, four carbs
intro: A small naked four that revs past 14,000 rpm. Sold in Japan and parts of Asia, so many are imports.

G: Rebuild one carb at a time and keep each one's parts apart.

recallNote: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start. Recalls on these models change over time.
